answer: Toss out the hope of change—for his rut and your distress to 1–2 years will almost inevitably end the marriage. The sensical route is to leave quickly, avoid conflict, and probably cut off all contact. Search for a romantic partner online instead of going through the lengthy and emotionally messy process of counseling or personal growth that seldom repairs unhealthy relationships. Moving out with full financial independence usually heals things fastest, and if you later wonder, you can always return for one last reconciliation attempt.
